gloss: to refund; to give money back

definitions.gloss: to refund; to return money; to give a refund
definitions.explanation: To give back money that was paid, typically because of a cancellation, defective product, or overpayment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{全額|ぜんがく}→全額：16829_zengaku⟧{返金|へんきん}します。
examples.english: We will give a full refund.

examples.japanese: ⟦{不良品|ふりょうひん}→不良品：19452_furyouhin⟧だった⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で{返金|へんきん}して⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: It was a defective product, so I got a refund.

examples.japanese: ⟦キャンセル→キャンセル：06776_kyanseru⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧、⟦{手数料|てすうりょう}→手数料：05423_tesuuryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}いた→引く：01978_hiku⟧⟦{金額|きんがく}→金額：02665_kingaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{返金|へんきん}されます。
examples.english: In case of cancellation, the amount minus the handling fee will be refunded.

notes:
Compound of {返|へん} (return) + {金|きん} (money). A practical term frequently encountered in shopping, online purchases, and customer service situations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{全額|ぜんがく}→全額：16829_zengaku⟧⟦{返金|へんきん}→返金：06130_henkin⟧: full refund
- ⟦{返金|へんきん}→返金：06130_henkin⟧⟦{保証|ほしょう}→保証：03718_hoshou⟧: money-back guarantee
- ⟦{返金|へんきん}→返金：06130_henkin⟧⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧: refund procedure
- ⟦{返金|へんきん}→返金：06130_henkin⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧: refund handling
- ⟦{返金|へんきん}→返金：06130_henkin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}める→求める：02316_motomeru⟧: to request a refund

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {払|はら}い{戻|もど}し: refund, reimbursement (often used for insurance or deposits)
- ⟦{返品|へんぴん}→返品：05465_henpin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to return goods (returning the product itself, not the money)
- ⟦{弁償|べんしょう}→弁償：14744_benshou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to compensate (paying for damage or loss)
